label: Scribe Contract
description: Model-authored scribe node. Receives a packed context bundle and emits a contract draft. Transitions with owner=model; the emitted contract carries a proposal tag and must pass script validation before entering an authority state.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Packed context bundle from ContextPacked state

inputs.name: pass_chain
inputs.description: Pass chain spec for scoping constraints

outputs.name: contract_draft
outputs.description: Model-authored contract draft. Tagged as a proposal — must be validated by a script (no_impl_leak) before route selection.
